CustomField.description: This field shows actual In Progress time excluding idle In progress time.
CustomField.formula: IF( AND(Total_Hours_In_In_Progress_Status__c = 0 , ISPICKVAL(uAssist_Status__c , 'In Progress') ), 0, Total_Hours_In_In_Progress_Status__c - Hours_In_Idle_State__c )
CustomField.label: Total Hours Actual In In Progress
